say:58:1510622048:1.female: If you're still afraid, just think of them as dried leaves. What reason have we to fear dried leaves?

say:59:1510622050:1.text: Let's go check out the <style="highlight">source of the sound</style>. Don't worry, I'll be right behind you.
say:59:1510622050:1.male: Let's go check out the <style="highlight">source of the sound</style>. Don't worry, I'll be right behind you.
say:59:1510622050:1.female: Let's go check out the <style="highlight">source of the sound</style>. Don't worry, I'll be right behind you.

say:61:1510622049:0.text: Either way, that sound will lead us to some answers.
say:61:1510622049:0.source_cn: 无论是哪种，这声音都能给我们带来一部分答案。
say:61:1510622049:0.male: Either way, that sound will lead us to some answers.
say:61:1510622049:0.female: Either way, that sound will lead us to some answers.

choice:56:1:2.text: Is it a call for help or a trap?
choice:56:1:2.male: Is it a call for help or a trap?
choice:56:1:2.female: Is it a call for help or a trap?

say:62:1510622038:0.text: The gods will not act, so we must be the ones to enact justice and take back the future from the fallen.
say:62:1510622038:0.source_cn: 诸神不作为，只能由我们主持正义，从堕神手中夺回未来。
say:62:1510622038:0.male: The gods will not act, so we must be the ones to enact justice and take back the future from the fallen.
say:62:1510622038:0.female: The gods will not act, so we must be the ones to enact justice and take back the future from the fallen.

choice:46:1:2.text: We just have to kill a god. Simple as that!
choice:46:1:2.male: We just have to kill a god. Simple as that!
choice:46:1:2.female: We just have to kill a god. Simple as that!

say:63:1510622039:0.text: If it were easy, we would not have met here.
say:63:1510622039:0.source_cn: 若是简单，我们就不会在此相聚了。
say:63:1510622039:0.male: If it were easy, we would not have met here.
say:63:1510622039:0.female: If it were easy, we would not have met here.

choice:46:2:3.text: Getting home is a lot harder than I thought.
choice:46:2:3.male: Getting home is a lot harder than I thought.
choice:46:2:3.female: Getting home is a lot harder than I thought.

choice:39:0:1.text: How do you know all this?
choice:39:0:1.male: How do you know all this?
choice:39:0:1.female: How do you know all this?

choice:36:1:2.text: Are you saying I'm not human?
choice:36:1:2.male: Are you saying I'm not human?
choice:36:1:2.female: Are you saying I'm not human?

choice:32:0:1.text: So, I have an anchor too?
choice:32:0:1.male: So, I have an anchor too?
choice:32:0:1.female: So, I have an anchor too?

choice:32:1:2.text: Why didn't you just look for my anchor directly?
choice:32:1:2.source_cn: 为什么不直接探知我的道标？
choice:32:1:2.male: Why didn't you just look for my anchor directly?
choice:32:1:2.female: Why didn't you just look for my anchor directly?

choice:22:2:3.text: Okay, back to the temporal anchor.
choice:22:2:3.male: Okay, back to the temporal anchor.
choice:22:2:3.female: Okay, back to the temporal anchor.

choice:16:0:1.source_cn: 之前就想问了，时空道标是？

choice:12:0:1.text: I'm counting on the power from his fall.
choice:12:0:1.source_cn: 我还指望着神陨的力量呢
choice:12:0:1.male: I'm counting on the power from his fall.
choice:12:0:1.female: I'm counting on the power from his fall.

choice:12:1:2.text: Of course. If only for the Wildborn's sake.
choice:12:1:2.source_cn: 当然，哪怕是为了雅库伯尔
choice:12:1:2.male: Of course. If only for the Wildborn's sake.
choice:12:1:2.female: Of course. If only for the Wildborn's sake.

choice:12:2:3.text: Of course. If only for Halia's sake.
choice:12:2:3.source_cn: 当然，哪怕是为了呼临城
choice:12:2:3.male: Of course. If only for Halia's sake.
choice:12:2:3.female: Of course. If only for Halia's sake.

choice:9:0:1.text: This is all because the God of Harvest fell.
choice:9:0:1.male: This is all because the God of Harvest fell.
choice:9:0:1.female: This is all because the God of Harvest fell.

choice:9:1:2.text: No wonder the God of Harvest is hiding here.
choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 难怪丰饶神会躲在这里
choice:9:1:2.male: No wonder the God of Harvest is hiding here.
choice:9:1:2.female: No wonder the God of Harvest is hiding here.
